summary_markdown: A discrepancy was noted regarding the calculated frequency within the campaign planner. Specifically, a calculation of 1.49 over one week was questioned, as the expected range based on formulas should be around 5-7. The communication plan is being moved to the data team so that someone can develop an algorithm for calculating frequency.
decisions: The communication regarding frequency calculations will be transferred to the data team.
action_items: Someone needs to develop a frequency calculation algorithm for the campaign planner.
